label: A populated actual esse chain separates same-field perfection from direct supreme goodness
paraphrase: Three actual bearers form the source-to-intermediate-to-recipient chain on one frame. The source is named, actual at esse and the common uncaused identity source. Named maximality, maximal causal exclusion, actuality-to-being, preexistence, goodness-as-actuality and per-edge transfer all hold. The one named bearer has single-field perfection. The distinct endpoint is actual in another respect but has no causal edge from the source at esse or at that other respect, so the existing direct supreme-goodness predicate fails.
